name: MARA sale proxy mints referral rewards into the LP pair
summary: The MARA sale proxy's payable buy entry point (selector 0x5fc985ea) mints MARA referral rewards to caller-supplied referrer addresses. The attacker bought with flash-loaned BNB naming the MARA/WBNB PancakeSwap pair as both referrers, so unsynced MARA landed in the pair, then swapped that surplus for the pair's WBNB.
notes: Loss is the 19.8 WBNB the MARA/WBNB pair lost (rule 14), not the attacker's 8.8 WBNB profit: the 11 BNB the attacker paid the sale proxy for 26,400 MARA bought tokens at the protocol's price and does not offset the pair's depletion.

The price slot the owner changed at block 42328559 only scales the MARA minted per BNB, so it sizes the loss and does not reset the age. A MARA mint-to-pair scan finds no other referral exploit; the later 5280-MARA mint is the deployer's.
